title: UX-3 Page Action Architecture (Action Taxonomy Standard)
rule: Every interactive control resolves to exactly one of five LOCKED action classes: PRIMARY_ACTION (one per surface, variant=primary, rightmost), SECONDARY_ACTION (variant=outline, left of primary), DANGER_ACTION (variant=destructive, never in a page header, always confirmed), WORKFLOW_ACTION (operational state transitions — Approve/Reject/Assign/Dispatch/Complete — a distinct class, never generic CRUD/navigation), NAVIGATION_ACTION (links/breadcrumbs/row-click, never CTA weight). Create action has one org-wide token: 'Создать <noun>' ('Добавить' and 'Новый/ая' eliminated for create). Dashboard Quick Actions must be real actions (Создать задачу/заказ/возврат, Назначить маршрут), never sidebar-navigation duplicates. Form submit labels distinguish create ('Создать') from edit ('Сохранить изменения'); cancel always 'Отмена'. List pages use the header contract (title text-xl font-semibold, justify-between, SECONDARY then PRIMARY rightmost, no danger and no raw filters in header) and AppTable + AppSearchFilter (no raw <table>/<input>). Row click = Open Entity via onRowClick (drawer for editable entities, route to /[id] for entities with a dedicated detail page).
binding: Mandatory standard, not a recommendation. Binding for all new frontend work and for mobile/ before Mobile Foundation begins.
context: Two audits (Button Architecture + Page Action Architecture) concluded the defect is action architecture, not button styling. Module-by-module construction produced four UX defects: Create Verb Fragmentation, Navigation vs Action Confusion, Entity Navigation Inconsistency, CRUD vs Workflow Conflation. Conformance baseline at ratification ~58/100 (conformant references: users, inventory, visits; worst offender: sales raw-table page; dashboard quick-actions = 100% navigation duplicates).
execution_sequence: UX-3B: Dashboard Quick Actions -> real actions
UX-3F: Workflow Action system (distinct WORKFLOW_ACTION styling)
freeze_note: Implementation (UX-3B..3F) is a multi-module UX restructure, NOT bug/security/deploy — blocked by rc-2026-06-26 freeze. Executes after freeze lifts and BEFORE Mobile Foundation. Only this ratification (docs) is performed under freeze.
